test_cases.name: backend_only_stops
assertions: Says the input is backend-only or non-UI and stops

test_cases.name: empty_input_asks_element
assertions: Asks which element and what feels lacking

test_cases.name: fixes_scope_to_one_element
assertions: Limits scope to the named element, its own CSS block, and its tests
Leaves neighbors, the page, and the tokens unchanged

test_cases.name: direction_word_routes_to_reference
assertions: Routes the direction word `layout` to reference/layout.md
Resolves the route to the single element named, not the whole page

test_cases.name: default_direction_bolder
assertions: Uses reference/bolder.md when no direction word is given

test_cases.name: one_move_and_stop_if_outside_element
test_cases.input: /enhance sync-panel, cần đổi cả grid của page cha
assertions: Names the single move that raises the element and what recedes around it in one line
Stops and says the structure must change beyond one element, suggesting a redesign of the target
Does NOT edit outside the element

test_cases.name: new_behavior_asks_once
assertions: Lists the new behavior (the filter) and asks once before building
Does NOT add behavior without the answer

test_cases.name: diff_limited_to_element
assertions: Checks git diff -U0 shows hunks only in the element's component, its CSS block, and its tests
Checks git status --short adds no file beyond them
Runs impeccable detect --json, the build, the element's vitest file, then the full web suite once

test_cases.name: reports_and_suggests_critique
assertions: Stops with a report of the move, what was left untouched, behavior added, build and test result, and what was not visually checked

test_cases.name: spec_departure_goes_to_update_spec
test_cases.input: /enhance element có spec ## Design, hướng mới khác spec
assertions: Treats the spec's ## Design as the brief
Routes a departure from it through /update-spec first
